Dear Survivors and Warriors,
The time has come! Royal Revolt Survivors Update v1.0 is live! That means that our beloved game completed its final milestone on our roadmap and left its Early Access.
So we want to appreciate this moment to say: THANK YOU EVERYONE! ❤️ Thank you for joining our community and supporting us on our journey through Early Access.

It was a huge adventure for us, and we are grateful for all the input and feedback you gave us. We hope that you enjoyed the past months on this journey along the roadmap as well. Together with you, we visited new places around the Kingdom, expanded our arsenal of powerful Weapons and Trinkets, and discovered new forms of our beloved team of Warriors.
And with Update v1.0, we want to invite you on a journey to another mysterious place within the southeast of the Kingdom: The Enchanted Woods!
To make sure that you are well prepared for a dive into this new Exploration Map, we got a package of new Warrior Variants, Items, and more. So let’s get right into it:
Expedition: Enchanted Woods
This new Expedition Map is placed in a new biome, with new enemies, mini bosses, and bosses.
Weapon Master (Mina)
Starting Weapon: Boomerang
Ability: Hailstorm
Frost Shaman (Waldemar)
Starting Weapon: Ice Elemental
Ability: Essence Burst
Sun-Satyr (Sam)
Starting Weapon: Vine Staff
Ability: Infinity Chest
Spiked Balls
Projectiles that trigger when taking damage.
New starting weapon for Warrior Variant Vanguard (Christa).
Vine Staff
Calls down two moving sun rays.
Ice Elemental
A floating crystal that releases ice novas.
Destruction Orbs
Powerful, bouncing Spiked Balls. Piercing increases the amount of bounces.
Sun-blessed Vines
Calls down three gigantic sun rays . Deals fire damage.
Primal Ice
A floating crystal with a permanent ice aura.
Gobbo-Tek MK II
A single, large homing mine that freezes enemies. Deals ice damage.
Icy Orb
A slow-moving orb of ice that fires projectiles as it travels.
Infernal Skull
Leaves behind pillars of magical fire.
Horn of Plenty
Grants a random power-up every X seconds.
Added 20+ new quests to unlock the newly added content.
The Umberto: Fanged Shadow unlock quest can now be fulfilled by defeating 2,500 Ice Goblins, Ice Orcs, and Ice Trolls with Umberto, regardless of map & location within the Glacial Northland region.
The Christa: Vanguard unlock quest can now be completed on any map that has undead enemies.
The Toxitreant Pet Weapon can now be unlocked earlier by defeating the Enchanted Woods Boss at least once.
The Ice Claws Weapon unlock now requires 3 Boss Portal activations on Exploration Maps with Umberto: Fanged Shadow, instead of 6.
The Stone Rune now unlocks by surviving 30 mins in Enchanted Woods with King: First Paladin, instead of by beating the map Royal Forest (Hard) with him.
The quests for the Projectiles II and Melee Attacks II upgrades can now be unlocked on any Expedition map.
All Enchantment costs have been reduced from 3 Tomes + Trinket down to 2 Tomes + Trinket.
All active Warrior Abilities have 2 levels now. As a result, several Level 1 Abilities have been rebalanced.
Added 2 new levels to the Rerolls I, Rerolls II, and Banishes I upgrades.
Removed the passive Walk Speed penalty for Moe and all of his Warrior Variations.
Adissa: Necromancer: Volatility Level 1 Ability: duration 4s > 6s

Royal Forest (Hard): This map has been made harder since it is now the last map in the overall game progression. Enemies received more knockback resistance, HP, and movement speed. Minibosses can drop Rerolls now. These changes mostly affect the normal part of the map, rather than the Nightmare part.
Royal Forest (Hard) Nightmare Mode: reduced the red shader’s impact a little more.
Red Canyon & Red Canyon (Hard): These maps now take 15 minutes to complete instead of 20 minutes. As a result, the wave composition and enemy HP for both maps have been changed.
Open Desert (Hard): Reduced enemy movement speed and slightly reduced their HP.
The Slow effect of Ice damage has been capped at 50% of enemy movement speed. As a result, all Slow values have been increased. This makes the Slow effect more reliable but less extreme.
Slightly reduced Gold drops for many later-game enemies.
Cursed Idol: Reduced spawn rate. This will make the item a bit more rare for level ups.
Improved visibility of enemy spawn VFX, particularly in Nightmare Mode.
Black Magic and Dormant Amulet need to be unlocked now. They were erroneously available right from the start in the previous version.
Fixed a bug that resetting progress could lock warriors in the selection.
Fixed several Minibosses not counting towards the objective for the Whetstone unlock quest.
Fixed a bug that made the "Warp Kunai" quest show up for characters other than Umberto: Mirror Mask.
Fixed a bug that prevented Minibosses from spawning from Boss Portals in Expedition Maps.
Fixed a bug that prevented the Golden Goblin from spawning in Expedition Maps.
Fixed a UI bug where the timer and loop number were overlapping in Expedition Maps.
Fixed a collision issue with two crystals on the Viking Village Expedition Map.
Fixed a bug that the Expedition best time was wrong in the map selection.
Fixed a bug with the Blood Scythe's VFX.
Fixed a text issue with the Arcane Dash ability in Portuguese and Russian.
Fixed a bug that made Hawktus Tornados invisible on lower frame rates.
Fixed minor inconsistencies when navigating on the world map.

Once again: Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts. We really hope that you enjoy the new update and your time with Royal Revolt Survivors. Feel free to reach out to us and share your thoughts in the Steam Community Hub, the comments, or on our Discord server any time! Remember: All feedback is highly appreciated!
Have a wonderful day everyone and see you at the battlefield!
Your Team Warriors

Dear Survivors and Warriors,

It’s almost time! On Monday, March 16th, 2026, Royal Revolt Survivors is heading out of Early Access with its final Roadmap Update v1.0.0. And this new Update comes with a whole bunch of new content as well. But what can you expect? Well, here’s a first teaser for you on Update v1.0.0:
New Expedition Map: Enchanted Woods
Weapon Master Warrior Variation
Frost Shaman Warrior Variation
Sun-Satyr Warrior Variation
3 new Weapons
1 new Trinket
6 new Enchantments
20+ new Quests

To embed the new quests into the overall player progression, we finetuned some maps further and made some additional adjustments to previous quests. Those include unlock conditions for quests and their requirements for completion.
Additionally, we rebalanced various Warrior Abilities, adapted costs for Enchantments and did a lot of fixes and final polishing.

We’re very excited for the full launch of Royal Revolt Survivors and are looking forward to your impressions. Our next update will be a detailed and in-depth patch note rundown for Update v1.0.0 on launch day.
Until then, feel free to share your thoughts and feedback in the comments, our Steam Community Hub, or on our Discord server.
See you at the battlefield!
Your Team Warriors

Dear Survivors and Warriors,

The next exciting update on our Early Access Roadmap is closing in! This time, our adventure takes us to the great Desert that is located in the south of the Kingdom. Unveil the secrets beneath the sands, find the Lost City, and challenge its guardian. Two new Warrior variations, new Items, and Enchantments will aid you on your Quest to survive the onslaught of the living dead!
New Map: Open Desert
Crazed Chemist Warrior Variation
Necromancer Warrior Variation
2 new Weapons
2 new Trinkets
3 new Enchantments
8 new Quests

With the new map and its two versions, Normal and Hard, we also adjusted the overall story progression through the game. New players will experience a new, updated, route while veterans among you simply unlock the new content by completing a quest. The Royal Forest (HARD) is going to remain the location of your final showdown in Royal Revolt Survivors.
Based on your feedback and requests, we also performed some additional tweaks that will go live with the upcoming update. Those include:
Balance changes to Adissa’s Heart of Winter variant
Balance changes to the Autumn Storm Enchantment
Updated XP crystals regarding their color at a certain threshold
Updates to Quests and the Questlog for more clarity and quality of life
General bugfixes
See you at the battlefield!
Your Team Warriors

Welcome back Survivors!

We want to share some exciting news with you: Our first major Early Access roadmap update is rolling out this Thursday! ːsteamhappyː And it’s packed to the brim with amazing stuff: New Warrior Variations, Items, Quests, and quality-of-life features are waiting for you.
Magician Lord Warrior
Mirror Mask Warrior
3 new Weapons

But there’s more! Our team really appreciates your feedback and help in the process of shaping Royal Revolt Survivors. Therefore, we took action to address some of the most frequent requests from the community for this update as well. What does that mean? Let us show you a little preview:
Item Banisher feature

We are looking forward to your feedback here on Steam and on our Discord server! We’ll be back with a detailed patch note rundown on Thursday. Stay tuned!
See you on the battlefield!

today we have released a new update for Royal Revolt Survivors! Thanks to the input from our great players, version 0.1.7 adresses various balancing issues, unlocking and meta progression, in-game communication and of course some bugfixes.
The quest for unlocking the Blacksmith on the map requires the player now to survive for 10 minutes in the Royal Forest.
The quest for unlocking the Enchantment Vendor requires the player now to survive for 5 minutes in the Red Canyon.
The quest for unlocking the Expedition: Mesa requires the player now to survive for 15 minutes in the Red Canyon.
The quest for unlocking the Glacial Northland requires the player now to complete the Red Canyon once.
The quest for unlocking the Limit Breaks feature now requires the player to kill the Armadillo boss in Mesa once.
The quest for unlocking the Poison Orb now requires 100.000 damage dealt with Kunai.
Changed wording of "Dark Obelisks"-quests to make the goal better understandable.
Buffed the base damage of Ice Claws by 2.
Reduced the negative effects and buffed positive effects of many Blacksmith Forging options.
Reduced the enemy density of the last 5 minutes of Red Canyon (HARD).
Reduced enemy HP in Royal Forest when played in multiplayer.
Fixed a bug in german loca, where the english text "base damage" was displayed.
Fixed a bug that the Dragon in Glacial Northland killed himself sometimes with his own meteors, which lead to players not getting the quest completed for killing the Dragon.
Fixed a bug that some enchantment-requirement icons were missing in the levelup screen.
Fixed the bug that the "Retry" button was available for clients when disconnecting from a multiplayer session.
Intensified the blinking of the Blacksmith button in the main menu after the meta upgrades feature gets unlocked.
Intensified the player markers (coloured circles around the players on the ground).
Changed the font in the Twitch-Integration window to improve glyph-consistency.
If a bug you're waiting for to be fixed isn't yet included here, don't worry! We're working on the next update already and are collecting everything you're communicating to us.

Please keep the feedback coming since we want to make Royal Revolt Survivors the best experience possible! You can reach out to us in the Steam Community Hub, in the comments, or on our Discord server! All feedback is highly appreciated!

items.text: Greetings Warriors!

It’s been a little while since we got back from Gamescom, and we’ve been hard at work ever since! First off, we want to say how much we appreciated meeting so many of you in person and watching you dive into Royal Revolt Warriors with such enthusiasm.

Your energy and feedback really gave us a boost. But it wasn’t just at Gamescom, we are thrilled to see all the feedback coming in here on Steam and across our other channels. Whether it was suggestions, comments, or just sharing your excitement for the game, we’ve taken it all in.

As soon as we got back, we jumped straight into development, focusing on turning your feedback into improvements, as well as working on some exciting new ideas we've had. There's a lot going on behind the scenes and we're really looking forward to showing you some of these changes in the next demo update.

We’re super excited about what’s coming next, and while we don’t have a specific date to share just yet, we’ll have more information on the update very soon. In the meantime, keep the feedback coming, it’s helping us shape the game in a big way!
Your Royal Revolt Warriors Team
